rationale: BrazilCo faces a projected USD liquidity gap of 450,000 USD at T+30D, with a supplier obligation of 650,000 USD and only 400,000 USD-equivalent currently available (220,000 USD + 180,000 USDC). To address the shortfall using one eligible conversion path, this proposal converts BRL to USD via the approved bank FX rail (FX-PROV-01). At the quoted rate of 5.4 BRL/USD plus a 20 bps fee, converting 1,350,000 BRL will yield approximately 249,537 USD (1,350,000 / 5.4 * 0.998), closely matching the USD-equivalent gap. This action does not presume optimality but demonstrates a compliant, eligible path to address the forecasted shortfall.
